title: A saved weight cleared in its box comes back when the box is left, and nothing tells the person why
evidence: Live 2026-11-13 (deploy 3fcac0d2, guest, Chromium and real WebKit): 78 typed and saved; after a reload, select-all and Backspace empty the box (it reads "" while focused, 800 ms later too); Tab puts "78" back at once, and a reload shows 78. Height clears and stays empty (a stamped null, US-10 AC9). An earlier run read "78" before Tab: it pressed Ctrl+A after Cmd+A, which on macOS moves the caret to the start, so Backspace deleted nothing. (1) Code path: the profile-row weight is renderLongitudinalField(WEIGHT_FIELD, box=true) (widget-src/src/components/InputPanel.tsx:751). Its value is rawInputs, else inputs.weightKg, else, for the box only, the latest saved weight from previousMeasurements (InputPanel.tsx:469, :501). A save deletes the saved value from inputs (widget-src/src/hooks/useLongitudinalSave.ts:134-141), so after a save the box shows the record's latest row. On change an empty box sets rawInputs to '' and inputs.weightKg to undefined (InputPanel.tsx:505, :515; parseAndConvert gives undefined, :345-348). On blur rawInputs is deleted (:521), so the value falls back to the saved row: the snap is synchronous, in the blur render, not on input and not from a re-read. The plan keeps the saved weight too (effectiveInputs falls back to previousMeasurements, widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx:199). The open waist field (renderVital, box=false) has no such fallback and stays empty with its Previous line (InputPanel.tsx:494, :792-799); BP shows inputs only (:835). (2) No AC covers clearing a saved weight, waist or BP. US-62 AC13 says the box keeps "holding the saved value" and that a number typed over it corrects it; US-10 AC9 covers clearing Birth Month, Birth Year or Height only; US-02 AC7 "only a truly empty box clears" is about profile number boxes. (3) iPhone, from code only (not run): a saved weight is not asked again in onboarding (ios/HealthRoadmap/Onboarding/OnboardingSteps.swift:74); when the weight screen does show, the box is filled from the record (ios/HealthRoadmap/Onboarding/OnboardingView.swift:381-383), an empty box disables Continue (OnboardingView.swift:155) and saves nothing (ios/HealthRoadmap/Onboarding/TypedAnswer.swift:114-116); My data shows weight as a read-only row that opens its page (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/MyDataView.swift:412-416). So no snap-back there, and no clear either. (4) Display only: no task is built for an undefined value (useLongitudinalSave.ts:97-100), so no row is written and none is marked entered-in-error. Live, the guest record (health_roadmap_file_v2) kept the same length, one weight mention and no entered-in-error before and after the clear, in both engines. (5) Options for Brad, none picked: (a) the box stays empty when left and a line under it says the latest saved weight still counts and how to correct it in history; honest, but an empty box beside a plan using 78 may look like a clear that failed. (b) keep the snap-back and add one line, e.g. "Saved readings are changed in your history"; least change, but the box still undoes the person's edit. (c) treat an empty box as no change and say so in the field (e.g. Replaces/Saved line shown while empty); clear about the rule, still no way to remove a reading from here. Nothing built. (H69)
